name: Rocket.Chat
description: Rocket.Chat is an open-source communications platform for team chat, channels, direct messages, file sharing, voice and video calls, and omnichannel customer support.

app_vars.name: var_admin_email
app_vars.label: Admin Email
app_vars.help: Email address for the generated admin account. Rocket.Chat needs a valid address here; it is not used to send mail unless you configure SMTP.

notes.text: Log in as `admin` with the generated password from `~/rocketchat.creds` in the container. Change it, and set a real admin email under Admin > Users if you kept admin@example.com.
ROOT_URL in /etc/rocketchat/rocketchat.env is the container IP. Change it to the public URL and run `systemctl restart rocketchat` before using a domain or reverse proxy, or logins and uploads break.
